text:
craig: FYI — JunoHealth RFI landed, 3d turnaround requested. They want a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers (HSM/KMS, data residency), + perf numbers for embeddings. PDF attached from them: <https://uploads.junohealth/reqs/rfi_2026.pdf>
anya: I can own the capability matrix + narrative. Will pull from product pack and previous RFI templates. @sachin can you handle the HSM/KMS wording and any certs? :+1:
sachin: Yep — I’ll draft the KMS/HSM answers. Short version we should use: "Redwood Private integrates with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and supports HSMs via PKCS#11 and KMIP; keys are not exported by Redwood-managed components." Will attach cert list (SOC2 + ISO) and a short diagram.
isabel: Quick Q — they specifically requested sustained throughput 500 req/s and embedding p95 < 200ms. Do we have a safe public number to include (with caveats)?
sachin: For Dedicated on our x8-rtu config we see embedding p95 ≈ 120ms at 500 qps in our internal bench (model: open-embed-3, seq=256). Recommended RFI phrasing: "Typical observed 95th percentile latency: ~120ms at 500 QPS on Dedicated x8; results vary by model and sequence length — see attached benchmark appendix."
anya: Good, I’ll put that into the capmatrix under "performance" with a footnote about model/seq length. Also need to present POC pricing options (reserved vs PAYG).
craig: @deploy-bot can you attach the latest embed-bench.csv and the current capmatrix draft to this thread so we have the exact numbers to quote?
deploy-bot: Attached: https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/juno/embed-bench-174985.csv, https://files.redwood/team/rfipacks/juno/capmatrix-draft-v1.pdf :white_check_mark:
isabel: Pricing note — Dedicated monthly min is $20k base (negotiable for POC). For PAYG we should list per-1k-token and per-embed unit price. I’ll draft a short pricing blurb.
anya: Plan: I’ll assemble capability matrix + narrative today, include sachin HSM blurb and deploy-bot attachments, then hand to legal for standard T&Cs. Aiming to send final RFI pack to Juno by 10am PT tomorrow.
craig: Action items — Anya: capmatrix + narrative (EOD), Sachin: HSM blurb + cert list (EOD), Isabel: pricing blurb + POC discount note (EOD). I’ll QA and send. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup: 
(attachment previews and small bench log pasted below)
